description: Lists the files in the vault's documents/ folder — bank and card statements the owner dropped in, and source files referenced by rows. Reads PDF (text-bearing), Excel (.xlsx) and CSV; anything else is listed as unsupported. A file still in iCloud is named so, with its download nudged. Start an import here, then read_guide "importing-statements" for the method.
name: list_documents
title: List documents
